title: Telemetry event (on-device only)
$comment: One event per completed search interaction, written to the app's LOCAL log and never transmitted. Only the distillate (distillate.schema.json) ever leaves a device. Sessions and dates exist here solely so retention and on-device pair mining can work; the distillation step strips both. Design: docs/telemetry-and-gap-mining.md §5.

date.$comment: Date only, never a timestamp — a time of day is an identity clue in a congregation.

session.$comment: Ephemeral, rotates per app launch, maps to nothing. Exists only so a reformulation chain can be reassembled on-device. Never exported.

outcome.$comment: converted = a result was USED (inserted, attached, added — the app's own conversion action), not merely clicked. reference = the query parsed as a direct scripture reference; logged for counts only.

target.$comment: targetId of the used result, e.g. 'WEB:24029011'. Null unless outcome is 'converted'.

rank.$comment: 1-based displayed position of the used result. Null unless converted. Doubles as an integrity check: the miner replays the query and flags events whose logged rank disagrees with the deterministic replay.
